annotations.description: Today's programme (films and showtimes) loads for the kiosk cinema.
Without the programme, customers cannot choose a film or showtime, so no tickets can be sold.

specs.title: API-03 Ticket types: an expired session is rejected

annotations.description: Asking for ticket types of a session that no longer exists returns a clear "Session has expired" answer.
A customer who waits too long on the kiosk must get a clear message instead of a crash or wrong prices.

stdout.text: GET content/trans/tickettype?cinemaId=0000000001&sessionId=0 -> HTTP 200 | code=11001 result=dialog msg="Session has expired" (32 ms)

annotations.description: Asking for ticket types of a session that no longer exists returns a clear "Session has expired" answer.
A customer who waits too long on the kiosk must get a clear message instead of a crash or wrong prices.

specs.title: API-04 Seat layout: an expired session is rejected

annotations.description: Asking for the seat map of a session that no longer exists returns "Session has expired".
The seat screen must not show an out-of-date seat map, which could lead to double-booked seats.

stdout.text: GET content/trans/seatlayoutkiosk?cinemaId=0000000001&sessionId=0&areacode=0 -> HTTP 200 | code=11001 result=dialog msg="Session has expired" (23 ms)

annotations.description: Asking for the seat map of a session that no longer exists returns "Session has expired".
The seat screen must not show an out-of-date seat map, which could lead to double-booked seats.

specs.title: API-05 Food menu: concession items are listed with prices

annotations.description: The food & beverage menu loads, and every item has a positive price shown in KWD.
A missing or zero price would let customers order food for free or block the food screen.

stdout.text: POST content/food/getfood -> HTTP 200 | code=10001 result=success msg="" (80 ms)
